limits: Native Ubuntu/macOS only; no WSL, native Windows provider, browser, model or final bilateral qualification.
Inherited leaf limitation calls the fixture WSL; actual recorded native environment governs this review. No WSL proof is inferred.
Negative admission deliberately tests archived a2e9ee6 reports; positive admission binds current candidate.
GitHub ZIP digests are advertised provenance; extracted file bytes were independently hashed.
Review-inbox/review-tooling suites retain separate evidence; the native runner does not execute them.

decision: Accept actual native candidate evidence for P01 fixture/runtime scope. Phase gate review is separate.
